lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኪዳነ ምሕረት እመቤት እመቤት /2/
ንዒ /4/ ሰኣሊተ ምሕረት /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ኣብ ልዕሊ ሰማያት ካብ ዘሎ ማሕደርኪ /2/[[/highlight]]
ዝማሬ ዝመልኦ ናይ ዘልዓለም ቤትኪ
[[highlight]]ፍጥረታት ናይ ምድሪ ማርያም ማርያም ይብል/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ብሰረገላ እሙ ለቃል ምጽና ድንግል /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ካብ ናይ ህድኣት ወደብ ካብ ናይ ፍቕሪ ዓውዲ/2/[[/highlight]]
ካብ ከተማ ሓቂ ካብ ናይ ሰላም ዓዲ
[[highlight]]ሰኣሊ ለነ ቅድስት ውዳሴ እንክስማዕ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ምስ ሚካኤል ምስ ገብርኤል ምጽና ካብ ራማ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ትነዊሕ ክዳንኪ ይውረድ ካብ ሰማያት /2/[[/highlight]]
ንንብዓትና ይድረዝ ናትኪ ኣማላድነት
[[highlight]]ዝማሬ ናይ ጽዮን ተመልአት ነፍስና /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ንዒ /3/ ንበል ከምቶም ኣቦታትና /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]በኣማላድነትኪ ፍጥረት ንክድሕን /2/[[/highlight]]
ኣማኑኤል ሂቡኪ ናይ ዘልዓለም ኪዳን
[[highlight]]በዚ'ውን ወለዶ ብጽእቲ ይብለኪ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ኣደየ ትምክሕተይ ምርኩሰይ ኮይንኪ’ኺ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ናይ ልቢ እንክነግሩኺ ሰሚዕኪ ኣይተጽቅጥን /2/[[/highlight]]
ንጽጉም ርእዩ'ውን ልብኺ ኣይጭክንን
[[highlight]]ከም ቅጽበት ዓይኒ ቀልጢፍኪ ትረድኢ/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ካብ ሓዘን ካብ መከራ ንስኺ ተዕርፊ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Kidane mihret ʾimebet ʾimebet /2/
Niʿi /4/ seʾalite mihret /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ʾAb liʿili semayat kab zelo mahderki /2/[[/highlight]]
Zimare zimelʾo nay zelʿalem betki
[[highlight]]Fit'retat nay midri Maryam Maryam yibl/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Biseregela ʾimu leqal mitsna dingil /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Kab nay hidʾat wedeb kab nay fiqhri ʿawdi/2/[[/highlight]]
Kab ketema haqi kab nay selam ʿadi
[[highlight]]Seʾali lene qidist widase ʾinkismaʿi /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Mis Mikaʾel mis Gebriʾel mitsna kab rama /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Tinewih kidanki yiwred kab semayat /2/[[/highlight]]
Ninbiʿatna yidrez natki ʾamaladnet
[[highlight]]Zimare nay Tsiyon temelʾat nefsina /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Niʿi /3/ nibel kemtom ʾabotatna /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Beʾamaladnetki fit'ret nikdihn /2/[[/highlight]]
ʾAmanuʾel hibuki nay zelʿalem kidan
[[highlight]]Bezi'win weledo bitsʾiti yibleki /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ʾAdeye timkihtey mirkusey koyniki’khi /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Nay libi ʾinkinegrukhi semiʿiki ʾaytetsqit'n /2/[[/highlight]]
Nitsgum riʾiyu'win libkhi ʾaych'iknin
[[highlight]]Kem qitsbet ʿayni qelt'ifki tiredʾi/2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Kab hazen kab mekera niskhi teʿirfi /2/[[/highlight]]
